params.1266: If You Plant It, They Will Guam
params.1273: Harvest a crop of guam from a herb patch.
params.1274: Guam grows from seeds. You can pickpocket these from master farmers (with sufficient Thieving), buy them, or play Vinesweeper for them.
params.1275: Head to a herb patch to plant them.
params.1276: Once cleaned, herbs are the core of the Herblore skill.
